text: In 2022, 0.6 ha of native forest was lost in the asset, representing 3.41% of its total area. This loss was primarily of native forest (0.5 ha), with no planted forest affected. The event was confirmed by both the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset and the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 reference, meeting the corroboration rule. The loss area was entirely within the mapped forest boundary in 2020. Additionally, there was 0.2 ha of forest loss in smaller patches (<0.5 ha) that year, which was not counted as part of the primary event. The data sources used were highly reliable, with full spatial coverage and no gaps in the annual series from 2001 to 2025.
